name: Hercules Sheet Metal & Metal Buildings
old_description: Since 1945, Hercules has been the Gulf South’s premier metal building supplier specializing in high-quality, customized commercial and residential metal building packages, roofing, and building components.
about:
Hercules Sheet Metal & Metal Buildings operates from Chalmette, Louisiana, where it was founded in 1945 as Corrugated Industries. The company remains a fourth-generation family-owned business; its origins trace to 1957 when William A. LeBouef Sr., great-grandfather of current owner Sara Bell, invented a continuous roll-forming system that earned U.S. Patent No. 3,009,511 in 1961.

The firm manufactures complete metal building packages, residential and commercial roofing, corrugated panels, and custom flashing and components. It runs its own roll-forming equipment — custom-cut roll-form machines based on the patented process — and uses high-tensile steel. Over eight decades it has sold more than 65,000 buildings and shipped over 75 million tons of metal.

Hercules serves commercial, industrial, and residential construction markets. Its building kits have been used for commercial garages, industrial warehouses, farm structures, prefabricated industrial facilities, pre-engineered workshops, sports arenas, office buildings, airplane hangars, self-storage units, cannabis cultivation facilities, and remote mining buildings.

The company emphasizes its 1961 patent as the foundation of modern roll-forming, 100% American ownership, and full customization of framing, finishing, and accessories. Financing options are offered to customers.

name: Hickory Furniture
old_description: For more than 125 years, Old Hickory has crafted furniture inspired by the American landscape. Today, that legacy continues with expanded fabric offerings, fresh design possibilities, and the same commitment to craftsmanship that built our name.
about:
Old Hickory Furniture has been handcrafting furniture in Shelbyville, Indiana, since 1899. The company began by using locally sourced hickory saplings and other natural materials, establishing a legacy of American-made rustic furnishings that continues today.

The manufacturer produces made-to-order furniture using methods largely unchanged from the 1890s, emphasizing sustainable sourcing and handcrafted construction. Its capabilities include custom design work, upholstery with heritage wool fabrics from a partnership with Johnson Woolen Mills, and the ability to accept customer-supplied materials. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Old Hickory serves both hospitality and residential markets. Its pieces furnish state and national park lodges, large family resorts, and themed restaurants, as well as high-end homes, private clubs, hotels, and vacation rental properties. Products are sold primarily through a network of retailers and interior designers.

It emphasizes its "Made in America" heritage and the durability of its hickory-based construction.

name: High Country Metal Works
old_description: Since 2018, High Country Metal Works has been dedicated to delivering precision-crafted metalwork for homes and businesses across the region. What began as a focus on high-quality railings quickly evolved into a full-scale custom metal fabrication shop, built on a reputation for reliability, craftsmanship, and attention to detail.
about:
High Country Metal Works was founded in 2018 in Provo, Utah, by co‑owners Cole M. and Connor V. The business began with a focus on high‑quality railings and grew into a full‑scale custom metal fabrication shop serving homes and businesses across the region.

The company fabricates custom metal railings, staircases, planter boxes, structural steel components, fireplaces, fire pits, pergolas, and gates. All fabrication is performed in‑house by certified fabricators with over 15 years of experience, and the shop also provides mobile welding and on‑site installation. Projects range from residential decorative pieces to light‑commercial structural framing.

High Country Metal Works works with homeowners, builders, and contractors throughout northern and southern Utah, including Alpine, Provo, Park City, St. George, and surrounding areas. Its portfolio spans residential remodels, new‑home construction, and light‑commercial builds that require code‑compliant metalwork.

The firm emphasizes craftsmanship, customization, and code‑compliant construction delivered with clear communication, in‑house fabrication, and professional installation. The founders say they “forge trust” by combining engineering precision with artistic design to create metalwork that is as strong as it is beautiful.

name: High Ground Electric
old_description: High Ground Electric has been providing residential electrical solutions to the Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Caldwell, and surrounding areas of Treasure Valley for more than 40 years. A trusted Electrical Service Contractor since 1975 and locally serving the people of Idaho and outlaying areas. We have grown from a flicker which provided exceptional work to its clients to a beacon who serviced the growth of various communities.
about:
High Ground Electric was founded in 1975 in Boise, Idaho, as a locally owned electrical service contractor serving the Treasure Valley region, including Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Caldwell, and surrounding areas. The company began as a small operation focused on residential electrical solutions and has grown over more than four decades into an established provider for residential, commercial, and industrial clients.

The firm provides electrical installation, repair, and maintenance across residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. Services include older home rewiring, emergency electrical response, and lead-safe practices compliant with EPA qualifications. Technicians are drug tested, background checked, and professionally trained. The company offers free estimates and emphasizes safety with a zero-tolerance policy for exposing clients to hazardous substances such as lead dust.

High Ground Electric serves homeowners, businesses, and industrial facilities throughout the Treasure Valley. Notable clients include Idaho City Hardware, which has relied on the company for multiple projects, and numerous residential customers who cite prompt service, written bids, and thorough cleanup. The company also extends a 10 percent discount to seniors, individuals with disabilities, military personnel, and first responders.

The company distinguishes itself through a commitment to customer service, describing its approach as providing exact solutions while listening to client needs. Its longevity and local ownership are presented as foundations for trust, with a focus on competitive pricing, guaranteed satisfaction, and staying current with industry practices.

name: High Peak Fabrication
old_description: High Peak Fabrication specializes in stainless steel, carbon steel and aluminum sheet metal fabrication. We laser cut and bend metal in thicknesses from thin to medium plate.  Uses include transportation, manufacturing, electronics, construction, machinery, among others.
about:
High Peak Fabrication operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, providing precision sheet metal fabrication services. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, though the business is represented by Todd, who speaks to the team's experience and pride in their work.

The shop specializes in laser cutting and press brake bending of stainless steel, carbon steel, and aluminum in thicknesses ranging from thin gauge to medium plate. In-house capabilities extend to TIG and MIG welding, PEM fastener insertion, tapping, and a range of finishing services including powder coating, sandblasting, zinc plating, and anodizing. The company handles prototypes as well as small and large production volumes, and offers assembly, packaging, and domestic or international shipping configured to Australian standards.

High Peak serves customers in transportation, manufacturing, electronics, construction, and machinery, with a noted focus on stainless steel design and installation for the food industry. Client testimonials reference work for Integrity Welding and Fabrication, ConcealFab, and Biac Broadband, the latter noting hundreds of products shipped worldwide since 2018.

The company emphasizes quality, reliability, and fast turnaround, backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification. It differentiates itself through design-for-manufacturability feedback, rapid prototyping, and a willingness to flag problematic features early in the design phase. Employees' experience and pride are cited as key to meeting tight tolerances and delivering components that match drawings.

name: High Speed Interconnect LLC
old_description: If the last place you want to compromise on signal integrity is at the interconnect, we’re your cable assembly company. By managing nearly all critical technologies and processes in-house we can assure you zero tradeoffs when it comes to insertion loss, phase stability, capacitance, velocity of propagation, and more.
about:
High Speed Interconnect LLC (HSI) was formed in December 2010 in Scottsdale, Arizona. The company quickly expanded through strategic acquisitions of Riverview Custom Cable and ESM Cable Corp in early 2011, then invested in coaxial cable extrusion and fine‑wire termination platforms. Corporate leadership and administration remain in Scottsdale, while manufacturing is conducted in two centers in Tigard, Oregon and Hermosillo, Mexico.

HSI extrudes its own high‑performance coaxial cable using solid, foamed, and expanded PTFE (VP90) dielectrics, and assembles cable assemblies ranging from 16 to 52 AWG. Configurations include single coax, twinax, triax, quadax, shielded parallel and twisted pairs, and multi‑conductor constructions in discrete, ribbonized, or bundled forms. The company manages nearly all critical processes in‑house — extrusion, termination, testing — and serves over 200 OEM and government‑agency customers.

The company serves aerospace, defense, medical device, and high‑frequency telecommunications sectors. Its customer base includes OEMs, government agencies, and universities. HSI is factory certified to terminate Hirose, IPEX, and JAE micro‑coaxial connectors, and its quality systems comply with AS9100D, ISO 13485, and ITAR requirements.

HSI differentiates itself by controlling nearly all critical technologies and processes internally to eliminate tradeoffs in insertion loss, phase stability, capacitance, and velocity of propagation. The company also emphasizes no minimum order requirements and lead times that range from 24 hours to eight weeks.

name: Hitachi Computer Products, America
old_description: Founded in 1987 in Norman, Oklahoma Hitachi Computer Products of America Inc shipped the first shipment of products manufactured in North America.  The original building was 78,000 ft2 and included our 1st Printed Circuit Board Assembly and Test line, and a Class 1000 clean room.
about:
Hitachi Computer Products of America Inc. began operations in 1987 in Norman, Oklahoma, when it shipped the first products manufactured at its new North American facility. The original 78,000-square-foot building housed a printed circuit board assembly and test line along with a Class 1000 clean room, establishing a base for electronics production in the region.

The site, now operating as the Hitachi Interconnecting Supply Chain Center (ISCC), provides printed circuit board assembly, test services, and clean-room manufacturing. With 35 years of manufacturing and logistics experience, the facility offers scalable process solutions designed to reduce complexity and improve efficiency across the supply chain. Product management and supply planning teams support these operations with advanced planning tools.

The company serves the computer hardware and electronics sectors, leveraging its location in the NAFTA corridor to reach customers across North America. Its global supply chain solutions are aimed at original equipment manufacturers and other partners requiring integrated manufacturing and logistics support.

Hitachi ISCC states its mission is to be the "factory of choice" by exceeding targets for quality, speed, and customer service to deliver the lowest total cost. The operation emphasizes environmental sustainability — targeting a decarbonized, resource-efficient society — and frames diversity as a wellspring of innovation. Its strategic position in central Oklahoma is cited as a logistical advantage for national distribution.

name: Holley Steel Inc
old_description: “We have been doing business with Holley Steel for 12 years, since 2008. In that time, they have done structural and miscellaneous steel work on 5 projects for us – CACC Library, Tallapoosa DHR, Airport Road School, New Housing Facility at Mt. Meigs, and are currently working with us on the new Reeltown Elementary School. Holley Steel not only does quality work but is a good company to work with as well. We look forward to continuing a working relationship.“
about:
Holley Steel Inc. operates from Elmore, Alabama. The company was founded in 2006 by Matt Holley, who brought over 40 years of experience in project management, estimating, welding, layout, fitting, and erection to the venture. Matt serves as chief executive officer, while his wife Donna Holley acts as chief administrative officer and co-owner, managing day-to-day administration. The business is family-owned, a point emphasized by the “We Are Family” motto on its website.

The firm specializes in structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication for commercial construction, providing estimating, detailing, fabrication, and erection services. Its 22,000-square-foot fabrication facility includes handrail bays, paint bays, a loading dock, three cranes with a combined 12-ton capacity, multiple welding machines, a drill press, an ironworker punch/shear, various saws, an industrial saw for heavy structural shapes, and an Ocean Avenger drill line. A separate 3,000-square-foot office houses administrative staff. Holley Steel handles jobs ranging from one ton to over 300 tons.

The company serves general contractors, developers, and engineers across Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Tennessee, Mississippi, and Pennsylvania. Past projects include the CACC Library, Tallapoosa DHR building, Airport Road School, housing at Mt. Meigs, Reeltown Elementary School, Robert G. Pitts Airport, Lifetime Fitness facilities, the Equal Justice Building, the Dr. William R. Harvey Art Museum, the Bluff Park United Methodist Church elevator tower, and a Rooms To Go distribution center in Gulfport, Mississippi.

Holley Steel attributes its repeat business to a reputation for quality and long-term client relationships. It positions itself as a partner that delivers timely, cost-effective solutions while adhering to safety procedures, with its “wheelhouse” being miscellaneous and structural steel fabrication for commercial projects.

name: Hologic
old_description: Unique to HIV is the disproportionate burden of disease in resource constrained countries and the historical response by the U.S. and European governments to provide billions in funding annually for care and treatment. Despite a 39% decline in new HIV infections since 2010, an estimated 1.3 million people acquired HIV in 2024, far exceeding the current target of fewer than 370,000.
about:
Hologic was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Londonderry, New Hampshire. The company was established to address women's health challenges through medical technology innovation, though the founders are not named in public materials.

Hologic develops and manufactures medical technologies for the detection, diagnosis, and treatment of health conditions, with a focus on women's health, diagnostics, and medical imaging. The company operates in 36 countries, holds more than 4,100 patents, and employs roughly 7,000 people. Its product portfolio includes diagnostic assays, imaging systems, and surgical devices, though specific manufacturing processes and facility details are not disclosed.

The company serves healthcare providers, hospitals, and clinics worldwide, providing tools for breast cancer screening, cervical cancer detection, and other women's health applications. Hologic's technologies are used by clinicians seeking greater certainty in patient care.

Hologic describes women's health as its purpose rather than merely a business, emphasizing a commitment to championing women's health globally through partnerships, policy advocacy, and efforts to remove barriers that prevent women from receiving care.

name: Hoosier Solar
old_description: Advantage Capital is a leading impact investment firm with an emphasis on driving capital to underserved urban and rural areas. The firm provides flexible financing to growth-ready entrepreneurs and industries located in communities that often lack access to conventional sources of capital. Since 1992, the firm has invested more than $4 billion in more than 900 companies to support more than 67,000 quality jobs.
about:
Hoosier Solar is a solar development company based in Knox, Indiana. The firm focuses on utility-scale solar farm projects across the state, working directly with landowners and local communities.

The company develops, constructs, and operates solar farms on leased agricultural land. Its process includes site assessment, land acquisition, permitting, and construction management. Hoosier Solar also implements a land restoration program: during the lease term, it plants pollinator habitats designed to the Purdue University Solar Site Pollinator Habitat Planning Scorecard, which supports crop pollination, reduces erosion, and improves soil health. At the end of the lease, the company removes all equipment and returns the land to agricultural use. Materials for the projects are sourced primarily from Indiana suppliers, and local crews handle ongoing operations and maintenance.

Hoosier Solar serves rural Indiana counties, landowners, farmers, and municipal governments. It partners with landholders to provide guaranteed annual lease payments, while counties receive additional tax revenue. The company emphasizes collaboration with local leadership to align project benefits with community needs, such as funding for schools or infrastructure.

Hoosier Solar distinguishes itself by exceeding state and local setback requirements, preserving existing landscapes, and committing to long-term land stewardship. The firm was founded on the principle that solar development should be a true community partnership rather than a passive investment, aiming to leave a legacy of fertile farmland and strengthened local economies.
